method: Viewed both rendered PNGs at original detail; checked all three prompt rows and both main/final columns.

observations.t2i: Short and long red-teapot scenes are coherent with complete objects and matching lighting/composition. Chinese poster visibly reads 周末咖啡 / 慢慢喝，慢慢聊; lettering, cup and cake match in both columns.
observations.edit: All three rows preserve the source scene geometry, cup and window/table while changing the teapot to blue; long prompt produces darker cobalt in both columns. No visible main/final difference.

pixel_evidence: Every pasted source RGBA pixel is unchanged and each main/final source pair is byte/pixel exact; this validates these fixed samples, not arbitrary prompts.
